comparative_quality: Not established by vendor benchmarks or package tests.
coverage: 20 memory candidates plus five document/application retrieval candidates; a broad shortlist rather than every existing repository.

decision.final_verdict: Recommend Hindsight as the shared native memory target for the new Claude/Codex runtime. Current stable pins, supported lifecycle controls and published native coding comparisons support this choice. A measured overall or token-efficiency winner is still unestablished; retain ai-memory as the operational reference until the replacement gates pass.
selection_reasons: Hindsight combines supported Claude/Codex integration and bank lifecycle controls with published conversational QA and native coding comparisons; our no-LLM backend trial passed scoped persistence, transfer and deletion checks.

Published SDE-bench comparisons report fewer corrections and 24.04% Claude / 52.26% Codex coding-agent cost reductions against no memory. They do not compare the five memory systems or include memory processing and hosting costs.
ai-memory remains the canonical operational reference. Latest 2.5.0 adds relevant routing and lifecycle features, but our 2.4.2 qualification does not qualify its new migrations or behavior.

agentmemory remains a retrieval challenger; its current upstream evaluator mapping prevents comparable quality scores. MemPalace is a reserve retrieval challenger, and Mem0 managed is a conditional comparator.
Only current deployable native capture, matched task quality and complete lifecycle usage can establish an accepted replacement winner. Keep the final-candidate field null until those gates pass.
decision.basis: Fit-based recommendation accepted by Astra/max after review of immutable published QA/coding evidence, actual scoped native outcomes and fresh upstream releases. Publisher coding comparisons use a no-memory control and older task-matched models; no new matched five-system quality or complete-cost run.
decision.scope: Fresh-prefix foundation installation and isolated current-host native store qualification. ai-memory 2.4.2 passed scoped lifecycle/recovery; Hindsight 0.10.2 passed no-LLM chunk backend checks; agentmemory's current upstream evaluator contract remains unresolved. No production migration, native coding-client capture or matched model-quality/cost acceptance.

candidates.name: Hindsight
candidates.rationale: Strong shared lifecycle fit and published QA challenger. Current 0.10.2 passed chunk-only retain/recall, restart, bank transfer and source/target deletion controls; integration capture stays disabled. Published QA uses 0.4.19 and substantial answering context. Full extraction/consolidation/reflection, native capture, matched quality and complete cost remain unqualified.

candidates.name: ai-memory
candidates.rationale: Canonical accepted control remains 2.4.1; the fresh CLI version probe reports 2.4.2 without requalifying a running service. Latest 2.5.0 adds server routing, repository identity and optional external lifecycle delivery, source-reviewed only. The earlier 2.4.2 trial passed 101 lifecycle and 65 recovery integration checks plus 42 upstream scope tests; those results do not qualify 2.5.0 migrations or comparative quality/cost.

candidates.name: agentmemory
candidates.role: local native coding memory and retrieval
candidates.rationale: Retained Mac REST-path retrieval remains a strong lead. Current unchanged eval stored 15 records and returned search results, but synthetic session IDs bypass the evaluator map, making two 0/15 scores non-comparable. Default keyless resolution is BM25-only unless local embeddings are selected explicitly. Native hooks, production C4 and complete cost remain pending.

candidates.name: MemPalace
candidates.role: local project memory with transcript capture
candidates.rationale: Current default saves directly with Python. Test short Codex sessions and full restore; vendor retrieval scores do not establish shipped capture quality.

candidates.rationale: Official Claude/Codex plugins ship, but their Platform API contract differs from the bundled OSS server; URL override alone does not establish local drop-in plugin compatibility.

candidates.name: Claude-mem
